name: Scheduled Task/Job: Scheduled Task
description: Detects Scheduled Task/Job: Scheduled Task (T1053.005) via Elastic EQL/KQL correlation
query: cron OR TaskScheduler OR schtasks

name: Create Account: Local Account
description: Detects Create Account: Local Account (T1136.001) via Elastic EQL/KQL correlation
query: event.action:("created-user" OR "user-created" OR "add-member") AND NOT event.category:authentication

name: Boot or Logon Autostart Execution: Registry Run Keys
description: Detects Boot or Logon Autostart Execution: Registry Run Keys (T1547.001) via Elastic EQL/KQL correlation
query: registry.data.value:* AND registry.path:("*\\Run\\*" OR "*\\RunOnce\\*")

name: Event Triggered Execution: Windows Management Instrumentation
description: Detects Event Triggered Execution: Windows Management Instrumentation (T1546.003) via Elastic EQL/KQL correlation
query: wmi* AND (process.name:wmic.exe OR powershell.file.script_block_text:*WMI*)

name: Hijack Execution Flow: DLL Search Order Hijacking
description: Detects Hijack Execution Flow: DLL Search Order Hijacking (T1574.001) via Elastic EQL/KQL correlation
query: dll.path:* AND NOT process.name:(svchost.exe OR explorer.exe)

name: External Remote Services
description: Detects External Remote Services (T1133) via Elastic EQL/KQL correlation
query: source.geo.country_name:* AND event.category:authentication AND event.outcome:failure

name: BITS Jobs
description: Detects BITS Jobs (T1197) via Elastic EQL/KQL correlation
query: process.name:bitsadmin.exe AND NOT process.parent.name:(svchost.exe OR msedge.exe)

name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: PowerShell
description: Detects Command and Scripting Interpreter: PowerShell (T1059.001) via Elastic EQL/KQL correlation
query: powershell.file.script_block_text:* AND process.name:powershell.exe

name: Valid Accounts
description: Detects Valid Accounts (T1078) via Elastic EQL/KQL correlation
query: event.category:authentication AND event.outcome:success AND user.name:("admin" OR "root" OR "administrator") AND source.ip:*

name: Exploitation for Privilege Escalation
description: Detects Exploitation for Privilege Escalation (T1068) via Elastic EQL/KQL correlation
query: event.category:process AND process.name:("sudo" OR "runas") AND event.action:("elevated" OR "privilege-escalation")

name: Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism: Setuid and Setgid
description: Detects Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism: Setuid and Setgid (T1548.001) via Elastic EQL/KQL correlation
query: process.name:* AND process.args:("-setuid" OR "chmod+s" OR "4755")

name: Access Token Manipulation: Token Impersonation
description: Detects Access Token Manipulation: Token Impersonation (T1134.001) via Elastic EQL/KQL correlation
query: process.name:* AND process.args:("runas" OR "impersonate" OR "duplicate.*token")

name: Indicator Removal: File Deletion
description: Detects Indicator Removal: File Deletion (T1070.004) via Elastic EQL/KQL correlation
query: process.name:(rm OR del OR erase) AND process.args:("-rf" OR "/s" OR "/q") AND NOT process.parent.name:(package* OR updater*)

name: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Tools
description: Detects Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Tools (T1562.001) via Elastic EQL/KQL correlation
query: process.name:* AND process.args:("disable" OR "stop" OR "uninstall") AND process.parent.name:(powershell.exe OR cmd.exe)

name: Obfuscated Files or Information
description: Detects Obfuscated Files or Information (T1027) via Elastic EQL/KQL correlation
query: process.name:powershell.exe AND powershell.file.script_block_text:("-enc" OR "-encodedcommand" OR "FromBase64String" OR "-decode")

name: Deobfuscate/Decode Files or Information
description: Detects Deobfuscate/Decode Files or Information (T1140) via Elastic EQL/KQL correlation
query: process.name:(certutil OR python) AND process.args:("-decode" OR "base64")

name: Masquerading: Invalid Code Signature
description: Detects Masquerading: Invalid Code Signature (T1036.001) via Elastic EQL/KQL correlation
query: process.code_signature.trusted:false AND process.code_signature.exists:true

name: Process Injection
description: Detects Process Injection (T1055) via Elastic EQL/KQL correlation
query: process.name:* AND process.parent.name:(svchost.exe OR runtimebroker.exe) AND NOT process.code_signature.trusted:true

name: Brute Force: Password Guessing
description: Detects Brute Force: Password Guessing (T1110.001) via Elastic EQL/KQL correlation
query: event.category:authentication AND event.outcome:failure AND _throttle_count:>10

name: Brute Force: Password Spraying
description: Detects Brute Force: Password Spraying (T1110.003) via Elastic EQL/KQL correlation
query: event.category:authentication AND event.outcome:failure AND groupby:user.name AND _throttle_count:>5

name: Credentials in Files
description: Detects Credentials in Files (T1552.001) via Elastic EQL/KQL correlation
query: process.name:* AND process.args:("*password*" OR "*credential*" OR "*secret*" OR "*token*") AND NOT process.parent.name:(package* OR updater*)

name: OS Credential Dumping: LSASS Memory
description: Detects OS Credential Dumping: LSASS Memory (T1003.001) via Elastic EQL/KQL correlation
query: process.name:(procdump.exe OR taskmgr.exe OR comsvcs.dll) AND process.args:*lsass*

name: OS Credential Dumping: NTDS
description: Detects OS Credential Dumping: NTDS (T1003.003) via Elastic EQL/KQL correlation
query: process.name:ntdsutil.exe OR (process.name:vssadmin.exe AND process.args:*shadow*)

name: Steal or Forge Kerberos Tickets: Golden Ticket
description: Detects Steal or Forge Kerberos Tickets: Golden Ticket (T1558.001) via Elastic EQL/KQL correlation
query: event.provider:kerberos AND event.action:("TGT-request" OR "ticket-granting") AND user.name:*$

name: System Information Discovery
description: Detects System Information Discovery (T1082) via Elastic EQL/KQL correlation
query: process.name:(systeminfo OR hostname OR uname) AND NOT process.parent.name:(package* OR updater*)

name: File and Directory Discovery
description: Detects File and Directory Discovery (T1083) via Elastic EQL/KQL correlation
query: process.name:(dir OR ls OR find OR tree) AND process.args:("/s" OR "-R" OR "-r") AND NOT process.parent.name:(package* OR updater*)

name: Network Service Discovery
description: Detects Network Service Discovery (T1046) via Elastic EQL/KQL correlation
query: process.name:(nmap OR nc OR netcat OR ss OR netstat) AND NOT process.parent.name:(package* OR updater*)

name: Account Discovery
description: Detects Account Discovery (T1087) via Elastic EQL/KQL correlation
query: process.name:(net OR whoami OR id OR dsquery) AND process.args:("user" OR "group" OR "localgroup")

name: Remote Services: Remote Desktop Protocol
description: Detects Remote Services: Remote Desktop Protocol (T1021.001) via Elastic EQL/KQL correlation
query: event.category:network AND network.protocol:rdp AND source.ip:* AND NOT source.ip:(10.0.0.0/8 OR 172.16.0.0/12 OR 192.168.0.0/16)

name: Remote Services: SMB
description: Detects Remote Services: SMB (T1021.002) via Elastic EQL/KQL correlation
query: event.category:network AND network.protocol:smb AND event.action:("share-access" OR "file-access") AND NOT source.ip:(10.0.0.0/8 OR 172.16.0.0/12 OR 192.168.0.0/16)

name: Remote Services: SSH
description: Detects Remote Services: SSH (T1021.006) via Elastic EQL/KQL correlation
query: event.category:authentication AND network.protocol:ssh AND event.outcome:success AND source.ip:* AND NOT source.ip:(10.0.0.0/8)

name: Hijack Execution Flow: DLL Side-Loading
description: Detects Hijack Execution Flow: DLL Side-Loading (T1563.001) via Elastic EQL/KQL correlation
query: process.code_signature.trusted:false AND process.name:*.dll AND NOT process.parent.name:(svchost.exe)

name: Application Layer Protocol: Web Protocols
description: Detects Application Layer Protocol: Web Protocols (T1071.001) via Elastic EQL/KQL correlation
query: network.protocol:http AND destination.domain:* AND NOT destination.domain:(*.microsoft.com OR *.google.com OR *.amazonaws.com)

name: Application Layer Protocol: DNS
description: Detects Application Layer Protocol: DNS (T1071.004) via Elastic EQL/KQL correlation
query: dns.question.name:* AND dns.question.registered_domain:* AND NOT dns.question.registered_domain:(*.microsoft.com OR *.google.com)

name: Encrypted Channel: Symmetric Cryptography
description: Detects Encrypted Channel: Symmetric Cryptography (T1573.001) via Elastic EQL/KQL correlation
query: tls.server.hash.md5:* AND NOT tls.server.hash.md5:(known_good_hashes)

name: Dynamic Resolution: Domain Generation Algorithms
description: Detects Dynamic Resolution: Domain Generation Algorithms (T1568.001) via Elastic EQL/KQL correlation
query: dns.question.name:* AND NOT dns.question.registered_domain:* AND length(dns.question.name)>30

name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
description: Detects Exfiltration Over C2 Channel (T1041) via Elastic EQL/KQL correlation
query: network.bytes:>10485760 AND network.direction:outbound AND NOT destination.domain:(*.microsoft.com OR *.amazonaws.com)

name: Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol
description: Detects Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol (T1048) via Elastic EQL/KQL correlation
query: network.protocol:(dns OR ftp OR icmp) AND network.bytes:>5242880 AND network.direction:outbound

name: Exfiltration Over Web Service: Exfiltration to Code Repository
description: Detects Exfiltration Over Web Service: Exfiltration to Code Repository (T1567.001) via Elastic EQL/KQL correlation
query: url.domain:(github.com OR gitlab.com OR bitbucket.org) AND http.request.body_bytes:>1048576

name: Exfiltration Over Web Service: Exfiltration to Cloud Storage
description: Detects Exfiltration Over Web Service: Exfiltration to Cloud Storage (T1567.002) via Elastic EQL/KQL correlation
query: url.domain:(drive.google.com OR dropbox.com OR onedrive.live.com) AND http.request.body_bytes:>5242880

name: Data Encrypted for Impact
description: Detects Data Encrypted for Impact (T1486) via Elastic EQL/KQL correlation
query: process.name:* AND process.args:("-encrypt" OR "--encrypt" OR "gpg") AND file.extension:(*.encrypted OR *.locked OR *.crypt)

name: Service Stop
description: Detects Service Stop (T1489) via Elastic EQL/KQL correlation
query: process.name:(systemctl OR net OR sc) AND process.args:("stop" OR "disable") AND NOT process.parent.name:(package* OR updater*)

name: Inhibit System Recovery
description: Detects Inhibit System Recovery (T1490) via Elastic EQL/KQL correlation
query: process.name:vssadmin.exe AND process.args:("delete shadows" OR "delete shadows /all")

name: Network Denial of Service
description: Detects Network Denial of Service (T1498) via Elastic EQL/KQL correlation
query: network.bytes:>104857600 AND network.direction:inbound AND source.ip:*
